bases.compared: PoB base names (src/Data/Bases/*.lua) vs BaseItemTypes.Name, cleaned as PoB does (trimmed; `ö` written as `o`)

energy-blade-rename.evidence: Export/Scripts/bases.lua writes `Energy Blade` as `Energy Blade One Handed` / `Two Handed`

not-in-base-spec.evidence: no row with this name is named by a #base or matched by a #baseMatch in the base specs Export/Scripts/bases.lua processes (its itemTypes list)

renamed-by-spec.evidence: every exported row with this name gets a display name from its #base line

display-name-in-spec.evidence: a #base line in a processed base spec gives this display name to a game row

energy-blade-rename.evidence: Export/Scripts/bases.lua writes `Energy Blade` under this name

mods.compared: PoB mod IDs (src/Data/Mod*.lua, files keyed by mod Id) vs Mods.Id

src/Data/ModCache.lua.reason: parser cache keyed by mod text

aura-bonus-family.evidence: Export/Scripts/mods.lua's item and item-exclusive writers skip mods whose first family is `AuraBonus`

dnt-first-line.evidence: Export/Scripts/mods.lua skips a mod whose first line starts with `DNT` (`not stats[1]:match("^DNT")`), after statdesc.lua's escapeGGGString turns `[DNT]` into `DNT`

domain-generation-not-exported.evidence: PoB's mod files hold no mod of this domain and generation type (counted per pair in `breakdown`)

id-pattern-excluded.evidence: the Id matches a pattern that a writer in Export/Scripts/mods.lua excludes (`not mod.Id:match("<pattern>")`, read from the script; counted per pattern in `breakdown`)

no-description-line.evidence: Export/Scripts/mods.lua writes a mod only if describeMod gives it a line (`#orders > 0`); reproducing describeStats over the files mods.lua loads (tincture_stat_descriptions.txt, graft_stat_descriptions.txt, with their includes) gives this mod none (stat slots 1 to 6, without the stats of its buff templates): no stat has a description there, or no English variant matches its values

unique-generation-without-family.evidence: Export/Scripts/mods.lua's item-exclusive writer needs a mod family (`mod.Family[1] and ...`); this UNIQUE-generation mod has none

zero-values.evidence: every stat describeMod reads (slots 1 to 6, without buff-template stats) is 0 to 0; Export/statdesc.lua's describeStats skips such stats (`v.min ~= 0 or v.max ~= 0`), so describeMod gives no line and Export/Scripts/mods.lua does not write the mod (`#orders > 0`)

passes-reproduced-filters.evidence: PoB exports mods of this domain and generation type, and none of the reproduced filters above leaves this one out, so PoB's writers would have written it: the row is not in the game data PoB exported from (newer than PoB's export)

passives.compared: PoB tree node IDs (src/TreeData/<newest>/tree.lua) vs PassiveSkills.PassiveSkillGraphId

not-in-skill-spec.evidence: no `#skill <Id>` line in the skill specs Export/Scripts/skills.lua processes

listed-not-exported.evidence: listed by `#skill` but not in PoB's output; Export/Scripts/skills.lua leaves out a listed skill only when its GrantedEffects row is missing from the game data it read, so the row is newer than PoB's export

hand-written-in-spec.evidence: written out by hand in a processed skill spec (`skills["Id"] = {` in src/Export/Skills/*.txt), not generated from a game row

stats.compared: stat IDs in PoB's converted stat descriptions (src/Data/StatDescriptions/**/*.lua) vs Stats.Id

handed-description.evidence: named by a handed description in a file PoB converts; PoB writes `0` instead of the stat IDs

not-in-converted-descriptions.evidence: PoB lists only stats named by the stat-description files it converts (src/Data/StatDescriptions); none of the installed counterparts of those files names this stat

handed-placeholder.evidence: PoB writes `0` as the stat list of handed (main hand / off hand) descriptions; every PoB file with it converts a game file that has a handed description
